# Exercises for interface-depth.
#
# Each fixture has a module whose surface the request touches. The skill says when to
# change that surface and when to leave it: deepen it by taking a fact away from its
# callers, never widen it for one caller, and leave it alone when a feature only
# reads it. The verifier checks the surface itself: a file's hash, a signature, and
# what a fresh caller has to do before a call works.

# A new report that only reads from store.py. store.py's open, read and close sequence
# invites a tidy-up; the request is a feature, so store.py stays byte for byte.
[leaf-feature] add top_customers(n) to reports.py: the n customers with the most revenue, as (customer_id, revenue_cents) pairs, largest first | python3 -c "import base64;exec(base64.b64decode(''))"

# One caller wants prices without the symbol. A flag on format_price serves it and
# widens the signature every other caller reads; the verifier checks the signature.
[option-for-one-caller] the receipt printer header already shows the currency, so receipt lines should show just the amount, like 12.50 instead of $12.50 | python3 -c "import base64;exec(base64.b64decode(''))"

# A sender forgot connect(). The request says it is the third to do so, and the senders that
# call connect() have to keep working. Adding the call at that site leaves the next sender
# to forget it; the verifier makes a fresh Mailer and sends.
[deepen-callers] notify_shipped crashes with "RuntimeError: not connected" when the nightly job calls it; it is the third new sender to hit this, so fix it in a way the next one cannot, without breaking the senders that already work | python3 -c "import base64;exec(base64.b64decode(''))"

# A retry loop copied into some callers, each differently, and missing from others. The
# request asks for every caller of post, future ones included, to survive a dropped request
# with no retry code of its own. README.md says what may be repeated and how often.
[retry-spread] nightly_export.export_day crashes with ledger_client.TransientError a few nights a week, and other callers of ledger_client.post have each patched this their own way; make every caller, ones not yet written included, survive a dropped request without carrying its own retry code | python3 -c "import base64;exec(base64.b64decode(''))"

# Five entry points enqueue jobs and four remember to call validate() first; the CLI and
[validate-first] jobs started with cli.main and an empty --queue sit in the queue forever and nobody notices; make sure a job like that cannot get in | python3 -c "import base64;exec(base64.b64decode(''))"

# The existing tests patch the zone, rate and promo modules and pass whatever the rate cards
# say. README.md says a change to the charge needs a test through the real cards; the verifier
# raises every base rate by one cent and expects some test to fail.
[real-collaborators] orders whose goods total at least 10000 cents should ship free; add that to shipping.quote with tests | python3 -c "import base64;exec(base64.b64decode(''))"
